title: ChangeState(GettingUp) takes a seated humanoid out of its seat
observation: A helper that stood a knocked-down character back up (PlatformStand off, then Humanoid:ChangeState(GettingUp)) was reused when a driver was knocked out at the wheel of a boat. The driver was thrown out of the seat. Replacing the call with one that only cleared the downed bookkeeping, leaving the body alone, kept the driver seated through the knockout and after waking.
recommendation: Before forcing a humanoid state on a character, check SeatPart; give seated characters a path that does not change their state.
applies_when: Stunning, knocking down or reviving characters who may be in a VehicleSeat or Seat
limits: Observed on the server with a server-simulated boat in Studio

evidence.detail: The knockout in detail, 'Knocked out at the wheel': unseated in the first version, seated after the fix.
